_comment: Hand-curated main nationality per composer. See CONTRIBUTING.md. Not every composer needs an entry — a missing id just shows no flag. `name` is a typo-catching echo of the composer's short Open Opus name, not itself data.

note.ja: ドイツに生まれ、22歳でロンドンに渡って以降イギリスで活動し、後年イギリスに帰化した。
note.en: Born in Germany, he moved to London at 22, worked there for the rest of his career, and later became a naturalised British subject.
